served_qa: Synopsis Aging Devil arc Synopsis After defying the orders of Public Safety and undergoing a week of heavy sedation, Denji is sent to the Tokyo Devil Detention Center for dismemberment. While Denji undergoes the slow process of dissection, Takagi, a member of Special Division 7, notes that no Devil has ever escaped from the Detention Center and that breaching it would require a full-scale war. Plot Summary Public Safety Saga Plot Summary Denji is a lonely boy who one day meets a Devil, Pochita. The two end up becoming friends, however Denji is soon killed and to save him, Pochita becomes his new heart, making him a human-devil hybrid and allowing him to become the Chainsaw Man. Soon after that, Denji meets Makima and decides to follow her and join the Public Safety and become a Devil Hunter. At his new job, he makes new friends, like Aki Hayakawa and Power, and together they go on different missions to exterminate devils. Eventually, Aki and Power are killed and Makima is exposed to be the Control Devil, who wants to control the Chainsaw Devil. Denji is then forced to fight and defeat Makima and her new squad of hybrids. Summary Chapter 218 Summary As the battle rages on, Asa orders Denji to eat her, believing she is already as good as dead. Despite all of her bonding, she knows that Yoru will never willingly return her body to her. Asa also believes that even if the Death Devil wipes out humanity, Denji could still survive. Still in disbelief, Denji asks her what would happen to her, and she admits that, due to the overwhelming guilt she feels over her actions, she simply doesn’t care anymore. However, since she wishes to go out doing something good, she urges Denji to eat her as she takes advantage of Yoru. In the real world, Yoru revives once more as Famine uses some of her own blood to accelerate Pochita’s recovery. She yells at Famine for being too weak and for sullying her holy war, but the Famine Devil retorts that Yoru is the true weakling as she revs Pochita’s ripcord herself. Before Yoru can retaliate, Asa momentarily regains control and turns her finger on herself, blowing off the top half of her head. Miri then intervenes, bisecting the War Devil’s body before instructing Death to deploy Guilly. In response, the Death Devil summons the Guillotine Devil and orders it to mince Yoru’s body. The Death Devil’s allies subsequently tell Chainsaw Man to consume her, but he decapitates them instead, making it clear that, in one way or another, he intends to save Asa. Synopsis Episode 1 Synopsis Denji is a teenager who lives his life as a Devil Hunter. Aiming to pay off the debt he inherited from his father, he starts hunting devils for the yakuza with his buddy Pochita, a "Chainsaw Devil", while living a tragically poor life. Just when things seem like they couldn't get any worse, Denji gets betrayed and killed by the yakuza. As Denji starts passing out, he hears someone calling from inside his head... served_qa: Personality Power Personality Power is childish, greedy, and almost entirely self-motivated. She tends to fight as if she has something to gain and is certain of her victory, and has no problems with running away from a fight where she is outmatched.(Chapter 24, Episode 8) She feels the need to boast her superiority over her fellow Devil Hunters due to her status as a Fiend. She has no loyalty to humans or Devils, openly admitting that she will join whichever is the winning side.(Chapter 29, Episode 10) Power also enjoys the thrill of a fight and enjoys showing off her strength and proving her own superiority. When she was in front of an swarm of zombies, she got excited and told Denji to watch carefully how she single-handedly defeats all of them.(Chapter 36, Episode 12) She is highly egotistical and often claims she is capable of doing things she cannot actually do, only to abandon them halfway through when the situation turns sour for her. She frequently deflects the consequences of her actions to those around her. Summary Chapter 82 Summary Elaborating, Makima explains that she looked into Denji's past and saw his repressed memories: the ones hidden behind the door that Pochita ordered him not to open. She explains that Denji hid the truth from himself in order to be able to live a normal life: The fact that he murdered his father. She goes on further, stating that Denji killed his abusive and alcoholic father in self-defense, and that the claims of suicide were merely created by the mafia so Denji would inherit his debts. Personality Denji Personality The trauma from Part 1 has clearly taken a toll on him. He displays practically none of the enthusiasm and upbeat demeanor he did before, and is constantly seen with a haggard expression and baggy eyes. He openly admits to Asa that he still hasn't gotten over his horrendous past. It is later revealed that he has nightmares where he tells himself he could never have a family because he killed his father, showing that Makima's words still linger in his mind. He's also picked up a habit of biting his finger when thinking of sex, which is likely a remnant of Makima telling him to "remember her bite." In spite of this, Denji still believes that life consists of more than just pain and that his reason to live makes him willing to endure the bad aspects of life. When asked what that reason is, he replies with sex, his main source of motivation. It appears that Denji has also developed a somewhat careless approach to his work over time, as there have been multiple cases where he had the ability to save more lives but chose not to, such as when he let the Bat Devil kill multiple civilians in order to save a cat or how he let the Falling Devil attack multiple people before he reacted in time to save a woman. He’s also still shown to be more forgiving to wicked yet beautiful women, as he still puts up with Yoru despite her murdering several innocent civilians. It is also implied that he had an addictive personality, losing large amounts of money to the Yakuza resulting in a massive debt which Denji later inherited. Volume Summary Volume 1 Volume Summary Denji's a poor young man who'll do anything for money, even hunting down Devils with his pet devil-dog Pochita. He's a simple man with simple dreams, drowning under a mountain of debt. But his sad life gets turned upside down when he's betrayed by someone he trusts. Now with the power of a Devil inside him, Denji's become a whole new man-Chainsaw Man! served_qa: Personality Fami Personality Fami has a very mysterious personality and shows little outward emotion. She is always calm, cold, and composed and also seems to be very good at reading others, as she accurately describes both Asa's and Denji's characters.(Chapter 113) Her knowledge seems greater than she initially leads on, as she possesses information that shouldn't be available to her. Fami doesn't care if someone discovers her true identity and therefore puts little to no effort into her alias. What's more is that she doesn't necessarily seem to be as outwardly malicious as her brethren, even informing Public Safety officials such as Yoshida about more dangerous Devils, albeit after being threatened first.(Chapter 122) Despite being intelligent, she can underestimate others, believing that Asa, like most people, would be willing to do anything to survive if forced to, which gets proven wrong. Chapters 113 and 122 Trivia Famine Devil Trivia Fami's rankings in the Popularity Polls are as follows: Fami ranked 26th in the Third Popularity Poll with 3,441 votes. Fami derives her power from Ypositismosphobia (from Greek υποσιτισμός: "malnutrition"), the fear of hunger or starvation. Fami has supernatural and religious elements tied to her character, most notably her wanting to save people from suffering via death, as the concept of starvation reduces human need to its most basic, undeniable, human level — survival. This extreme need for mere existence can be paralleled with the absolute, all-consuming nature of faith or ultimate concerns like life and death, reflecting a warped, fatalistic benevolence tied to basic human survival. Personality Famine Devil Personality Fami has a meek and taciturn demeanor and is very outwardly emotional, in stark contrast with her sisters. She was nervous when introducing herself to students of Fourth East High School, crying throughout her entire introduction and openly bawling when she saw that nobody was paying attention to her. At the same time, she appears to have somewhat of a high opinion of herself, refusing to take out the trash because it would be a waste of her superior talents. Despite this, when she's chastised by a student for her behavior and told to go "crush ants", she actually goes outside to do so. When she's easily dispatched by the Fake Chainsaw Man, she immediately resorts to begging for her life by offering him a meager ¥2,000 from her wallet, demonstrating an overt cowardice that her sisters lack. Relationships / Yoru Famine Devil Relationships / Yoru Fami does not like Yoru or her ideals of endless war. In addition, she appears to dislike her showboating and boisterous personality, which is exacerbated by Yoru thinking that Fami is incredibly weak.
